headline: United Bank for Africa Enables Google Pay for Cardholders
summary: United Bank for Africa has become the first bank to enable Google Pay for eligible Visa and Mastercard users, expanding its digital payments infrastructure.
why: UBA is one of Africa's largest commercial banks with operations in 20 African nations, and digital payment partnerships drive retail transaction volume.

impacts.name: United Bank for Africa
impacts.why: Google Pay integration increases digital transaction fees and expands retail customer engagement.
